question: Do exact raw-Nesterov learning rates fitted at one finite outer-call horizon incur a fresh held-out penalty when deployed verbatim at another horizon?

eta_T5_source.fit: five-seed OLS quadratic in endpoint NLL versus log2(eta), raw T=5 curve

eta_T20_source.fit: five-seed OLS quadratic in endpoint NLL versus log2(eta), raw T=20 curve

eta_T40_source.provenance: independently registered pre-outcome V11 far-horizon fitted prescription; no V10 or T40 outcome

evaluation.primary_metric: endpoint negative log-likelihood in bits per token
evaluation.paired_penalty: [heldout_loss(exact source eta)-heldout_loss(target fitted eta)]/ln(2), paired by fresh training seed

heldout_audit_jsonl.reserved_shard_convention: the confirmation-audit stream hash-bound alongside v6/v9-style train/development splits; it was not passed to the v4/v4c source-rate runs or used to fit any V10 eta

surface_prediction.T40_curvature_rule: use the nearest registered 1.7B long-horizon raw curvature donor, G4C T20; do not inspect a T40 outcome

gate.name: G10
gate.threshold_rule: one half of the minimum prospectively surface-predicted directed penalty: 0.5 * min(0.6511960552963959,1.5377622174721652,0.3570843419472711)

uncertainty.method: all 3^3=27 ordered paired fresh-seed bootstrap resamples independently for each directed contrast
uncertainty.gate_uses: the three directed interval endpoints; the equal-weight three-direction summary is descriptive

classification.PENALTY_CONFIRMED: all three directed 95% interval lower endpoints are >= +0.17854217097363556 bits/token
classification.PENALTY_REVERSED: all three directed 95% interval upper endpoints are <= -0.17854217097363556 bits/token
classification.PENALTY_NULL: every other complete finite result, including mixed directions or intervals entering the practical-null band

gate.execution_incompleteness: infrastructure-incomplete work emits no G10 verdict and must be recovered under the registered retry rule; it is not a fourth scientific category

banked_v4_seed_noise.estimator: sample SD across paired seeds for every within-horizon pair of raw eta rungs, pooled over the six-rung T5 and T20 G4C curves
banked_v4_seed_noise.band_justification: the 0.178542-bit practical threshold is 1.091x the worst banked paired-contrast sample SD and 2.619x the pooled SD, while retaining exactly half of the smallest surface-predicted penalty

execution.progressive_claim_rule: a V10 slot may launch only after the containing reduced-v9 four-GPU island controller is absent and the exact GPU has no compute process
execution.tonight85_priority_registration: run_slot_v10.py and a v10-transfer priority guard both match tonight85_conductor.py PRIORITY_REMOTE

retry_contract.retry_unit: both transfer and comparator cells sharing target horizon and training seed
